styleguide.title: Design system
styleguide.intro: Colors, type, and core components for ListenLoop. This page is not linked from navigation.

specimen.body: A seven-day loop: dictation on Day 1, shadowing on Days 2–6, and a re-dictation on Day 7 to see your progress.

pixelFish.intro: Style: realistic colors, big cute eyes. True-to-life patterns, colors, and light; eyes about 1/3 of the head’s height with one big and one small glint; a slightly rounder, shorter body. They blink now and then and look at the pointer or food; happy ^ ^ after eating; hungry with half-closed lids, slower and lower. Colors, eye size, and other knobs live in lib/pixel-fish/style.ts.
pixelFish.tankLabel: A {name} swimming in a pixel-art aquarium
pixelFish.reduced: Reduced motion is on: the fish stays still, doesn’t blink, and its eyes don’t move. The buttons switch still expressions.
pixelFish.lookHint: Move the pointer or a finger over the tank and the fish looks at it; it watches food as it sinks.
pixelFish.togetherHint: From small to big: snail < clownfish < great white < whale shark. The whale shark is the slowest; the snail creeps along the glass and the floor.
pixelFish.togetherLabel: A snail, a clownfish, a great white, and a whale shark in one pixel-art aquarium
pixelFish.snailNote: Eyes on the tentacle tips; a shell with a logarithmic spiral; creeps along the glass and the floor.
pixelFish.clownfishNote: Three white bands edged in black, black fin margins.
pixelFish.greatWhiteNote: Still a shark: pointed snout, grey back and white belly, gill slits, tall dorsal fin, crescent tail; short and chubby with a little toothy smile.
pixelFish.whaleSharkNote: The biggest and slowest: a broad flat head with a wide front mouth, white spots and faint stripes, white belly.

player.captionHint: If captions appear, turn them off with the CC button at the bottom right of the player so they don’t give away the answer.

timing.title: Timing check
timing.intro: Play each sentence and nudge its start and end by 0.1 s. Playback adds the same padding learners hear (0.15 s before, 0.25 s after, never into a neighboring sentence). When it sounds right, copy the JSON and send it to the developer.
timing.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy automatically. Select the text below instead.
timing.tapIntro: Play from a starting point and press Space as each sentence begins (on a phone, press “Sentence starts”); press Enter when the last one ends (or “Last sentence ended”). The taps are applied right away; then play each sentence below to fine-tune.
timing.tapEnd: All tapped. Press Enter when the last sentence ends.
timing.tapDone: {count, plural, one {# sentence} other {# sentences}} marked. Play each one to check, then copy the JSON.

dictation.title: Day 1: Dictation
dictation.intro: Listen to one sentence at a time and type what you hear. Your first submission is scored; after that you can replay and see the answer.
dictation.saveFailed: Couldn’t save your progress. Allow this site to store data (for example, leave private browsing), then reload.
dictation.shortcuts: Enter to submit · Ctrl+Space or Ctrl+Enter to replay
dictation.notesHint: After you submit, this sentence’s translation, vocabulary, and grammar appear here.
dictation.practiceMode: Practice mode: this score won’t change your official score ({score}).

redictation.title: Day 7: Re-dictation
redictation.intro: Dictate the whole video once more. You’ll compare with Day 1; 80% accuracy or more passes the week.

handout.title: Bilingual handout
handout.printHint: In the print dialog, set the destination to “Save as PDF”.
handout.locked: Finish Day 1 dictation to unlock the handout. Listening first, then checking the handout, shows the most progress.

shadowing.title: Day {day}: Shadowing
shadowing.intro: Listen to a sentence, then say it. Saying at least 70% of the words completes it; finish every sentence each day. Chrome on a computer works best.
shadowing.shortcuts: Enter to continue · Ctrl+Space or Ctrl+Enter to replay
shadowing.saveFailed: Couldn’t save your progress. Allow this site to store data (for example, leave private browsing), then reload.
